title: Send and receive read receipts per the jmap-chat-mimi mapping
description: Inbound: deliveredAt/readAt in deliveryReceipts from other members; own clients' reads set readAt and may advance ReadPosition. Outbound: read (and optionally delivered) reports unless receiptSharing is false or the room's status_notification_policy (room-policy-04 §6.1) forbids them.
